tool_detail.description:
Plan a deck from a brief — an ordered slide outline with narrative roles (opening, evidence, comparison, close), a canonical layout per slide (opening "title" and closing "closing" with no pattern; content slides "blank-title" plus a pattern) and content seeds. Rhythm: no 3 consecutive slides with the same pattern; emphasis (stat-hero, pull-quote) only for the brief's own headline number or quote.

format:"deckspec" (recommended) returns deck_spec — a DeckSpec draft whose kinds follow the brief — plus slots[] (path, guidance, facts), unplaced_facts[], constraints[] ("8 slides", "on midnight-blue") and budget / budget_note. A sentence that names a slide in the kind catalogue's own words is drafted as that kind, in brief order, with its facts in the kind's fields (bridge, matrix_2x2, image_case, architecture, team, decision / option_matrix, roadmap, process, table, comparison, kpi_snapshot, chart_insight, regions); the narrative defaults are drafted from what is left, and "Ask:" / next steps is the one closer. The cover carries the deck name the brief gives, else __FILL__ — never a cut fragment; no dividers under 12 slides unless asked. Fill the rest from list_slide_kinds, then validate_deck_spec → render_deck_spec.

The plan's slides[] are advisory records, NOT SlideInput objects. For a raw deck, copy each slides[i].skeleton into presentation.slides[], replace its __FILL__ tokens and validate before generating.

audience.description: Target audience (e.g., 'board of directors', 'engineering team', 'investors'). Influences pattern selection.

brief.description: Natural-language description of the deck purpose and content (e.g., 'Pitch our Series B for an AI infra company').

format.description: "raw" (default): pattern outline with raw SlideInput skeletons for the raw path. "deckspec": a DeckSpec draft for validate_deck_spec / render_deck_spec — the slides the brief names, by kind and in brief order, then the narrative slots drafted from what is left.

must_include.description: Pattern names that must appear in the plan (e.g., ["bmc-canvas", "kpi-3up"]).

slide_budget.description: Target number of slides (3–30). Default: the count the brief states, else 10.

template.description: Template name. Every planned slide then carries template_support {status: supported|risky|unsupported, reasons[], required_layout}, and a pattern the template cannot host is replaced with a supported alternative.
